messages.content: You are debugging an overloaded vLLM deployment on a DGX Spark. Interactive p99 latency doubled during a burst while aggregate token throughput stayed nearly flat. Long prompts and ongoing decode requests share the server. Explain how you would distinguish queueing delay, mixed prefill/decode interference, CUDA Graph replay effects, and slow GPU execution. Name the first controlled experiment you would run and the evidence that would falsify your hypothesis.
